response.original_title: STAR WARS: Revenge of the Sith Ultimate Edition Part I
response.overview: Anakin and Obi-Wan are forced to return home to Coruscant, while Darth Sidious enacts the final steps of his master plan to rule the galaxy. Meanwhile, Ahsoka leads a mission to capture Maul and free Mandalore from his control. This is a fan edit by Jedi's Knowledge that includes Revenge of the Sith with four (generally accepted as canon) deleted scenes, the final The Clone Wars arc, Tales of the Jedi S1:E5, a scene from Tales of the Empire S1:E4, a scene from Tales of the Jedi S1:E6.
